Author: platis
Name: XIV.fm
Punchline: Share what you are listening to in Final Fantasy XIV.
Description: XIV.fm displays Last.fm listening presence on cards anchored above player nameplates.
Changelog:
- Automatically select newly created or joined Custom Relays and activate Custom privacy.
- Show listening cards only while a synchronized track is playing.
- Add expandable Relay tables with group details and owner controls.
- Default development mode to the invited public XIV.fm test endpoint.
